name: Stacks
description: Chord-progression tool, ported from the Schwung module for Ableton Move. Plays chords into Live on the selected track, follows Live's MIDI clock, runs on Push's screen, pads and buttons (Shift + Help), and in listen mode names the chord you play on the screen. The Push surface needs push-manager and push-display from a Push Hack release with pass-through buttons and raw frames; without them Stacks still plays and its browser panel works.
author: rgeissen
